sample_control.THIS_experiment_2021: OBSERVATION_ONLY. Only 2021 labels and ciphertext catalog decrypted.
sample_control.proviso: These later periods have been analyzed in previous, separate projects; they are not virgin/never-seen data overall.

definitions.partition: Each rider ranked by the marginal market support for that exact finishing position; rank bins [1,2],[3,4],[5,n]. 27 Cartesian products of those position sets, remove repeated riders.
definitions.unit_of_observation: Each race contributes ONE actual set hit; for EACH of 27 sets adds its pre-event market mass. No selected bets.
definitions.null_variance: sum_r q_r(F)*(1-q_r(F)); z is descriptive and not corrected for 27 comparisons or race/day dependence.
definitions.no_purchase: No ROI, investment, synthetic odds threshold, best subset search, train/test fitting, or production change performed.
definitions.market_vs_truth: Odds-normalized support is market IMPLIED distribution, NOT known true probability.
definitions.preexisting_orientation: 2021 each n independently verified at public labeled odds before canonical (a,b,c) use.

limitations: 27 fixed disjoint band-signature formations do NOT exhaust all possible unions or overlapping formations.
Market rank bands are ex-ante descriptive partitions, not a hypothesis fitted to 2021 results.
All odds are final historical not T-15; observations cannot certify live profitability.
Multiple comparisons and race-level dependence make large z scores exploratory only.
No market underpricing or positive expected betting returns are inferred until independent validation and exact stakes.
No rider-line roles present in this observation; no claim about line-specific subsets.
